subject: How to change binning on POSIXct histograms?

messages.author: 220a837c7e01fe97
messages.subject: How to change binning on POSIXct histograms?
parts:
Hi, I'm making a histogram of start times (POSIXct). For example,
qplot(startTime, data=df) . This chooses some reasonable bin width (a
few hours in my case).

But how can I explicitly control the binning? Like,
hist( df$startTime, breaks="30 mins")

The "breaks" argument to stat_bin doesn't seem to accept the time
break specification.

I've tried playing with the binwidth argument, but that seems to only
accept a number. I give it a number and R churns and churns and I have
to kill it. Not sure what that is doing, but whatever it is it's bad.

Is there a way to explicitly set the binning for a POSIXct histogram?

Thanks!
--- Adam

messages.author: 220a837c7e01fe97
messages.subject: Re: How to change binning on POSIXct histograms?
parts:
Well ok - I can do this...

> df$cuts <- cut(df$startTimeP, breaks="2 hours")
> dd <- as.data.frame.table(table(df$cuts))
> dd$p <- as.POSIXct( as.character(dd$Var1) )
> qplot(p, Freq, data=dd, geom="step")

But can I do this within histogram (which looks much nicer)?

Thanks again...

--- Adam
